description: Figure 15 of Feucht et al. 2026 (arXiv:2605.01148), residual-stream patching on the weekdays task: interchange the whole residual stream at every depth x token position and score each interchange against the three causal variables' labels, one child per depth. workflows/scripts/arithmetic_fig15/fig15_figure.py draws the three heatmaps from the joined tables.
